name: Okeānija
storyline: You are a shipwreck survivor washed ashore on an uninhabited tropical island. You must clean up the wilderness, gather resources, build shelters, craft tools, grow crops and expand until you turn the island into a thriving territory and become its governor.
summary: Master the entire island and free up space for your activities, gradually clear the island of wild thickets in search of valuable resources. To survive on the island, have to engage in land cultivation and animal husbandry. You will need to be tactical about what and when to grow in your plantations. But the most important thing to become the governor of the island will be earning a reputation.
